sourceReferences.supports: In contemporary standard Russian, prepositional согласно governs the dative, not the genitive. Согласно means in accordance with / according to and introduces a rule, document, order, or criterion. Normative examples include согласно закону, согласно договору, согласно приказу, and согласно новым правилам.
